<p style="margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: -6px;">
 	<font face="Times New Roman" size="2">
 		NEWS RELEASE<p>Release Time<br>IMMEDIATE<p>Date<br>24 March 2011<p>Number 10/11<p>EXPANSION OF HUNTER VALLEY ENERGY COAL<p>BHP Billiton today announced approval of a US$400 million investment to expand Hunter Valley Energy Coal in New South Wales, Australia.<p>The expansion, known as the RX1 Project (RX1), will enable Mt Arthur Coal&#8217;s run-of-mine thermal coal production to increase by 4 million tonnes per annum (mtpa), to approximately 24 mtpa. RX1 is substantially a mine only expansion without an associated increase in coal preparation plant capacity.<p>RX1 is expected to deliver first production in the second half of the 2013 calendar year. In addition to the employment generated by the project during construction, the RX1 expansion is expected to generate approximately 300 new, full time jobs.<p>BHP Billiton Energy Coal President, Jimmy Wilson, said &#8220;The emergence of demand for coal in the key growth markets allows us to get product to market quickly, ahead of further coal preparation plant expansions. Importantly, the RX1 Project will take advantage of existing port capacity and future expansion options will be supported by Mt Arthur Coal&#8217;s large, low cost resource and the ability to expand the coal processing facilities.&#8221;<p>BHP Billiton owns 100 percent of Mt Arthur Coal through Hunter Valley Energy Coal Pty Ltd.<p>Further information on BHP Billiton can be found on our Internet site: www.bhpbilliton.com<p>Australia<br>Brendan Harris, Investor Relations<br>Tel: +61 3 9609 4323  Mobile: +61 437 134 814<br>email: Brendan.Harris@bhpbilliton.com<p>Amanda Buckley, Media Relations<br>Tel: +61 3 9609 2209  Mobile: +61 419 801 349<br>email: Amanda.Buckley@bhpbilliton.com<p>Kelly Quirke, Media Relations<br>Tel: +61 3 9609 2896  Mobile: +61 429 966 312  <br>email: Kelly.Quirke@bhpbilliton.com  <p>Samantha Stevens, Media Relations<br>Tel: +61 3 9609 2898  Mobile: +61 400 693 915  <br>email: Samantha.Stevens@bhpbilliton.com&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<p>United Kingdom & South Africa<br>Andre Liebenberg, Investor Relations <br>Tel: +44 20 7802 4131  Mobile: +44 7920 236 974<br>email: Andre.Liebenberg@bhpbilliton.com<p>United Kingdom & Americas<br>Ruban Yogarajah, Media Relations<br>Tel: US +1 713 966 2907 or UK +44 20 7802 4033<br>Mobile: UK +44 7827 082 022<br>email: Ruban.Yogarajah@bhpbilliton.com<p>Americas<br>Scott Espenshade, Investor Relations<br>Tel: +1 713 599 6431&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Mobile: +1 713 208 8565<br>email: Scott.Espenshade@bhpbilliton.com<p>BHP Billiton Limited ABN 49 004 028 077<br>Registered in Australia<br>Registered Office: 180 Lonsdale Street<br>Melbourne Victoria 3000 Australia<br>Tel +61 1300 55 4757 Fax +61 3 9609 3015<p>BHP Billiton Plc Registration number 3196209<br>Registered in England and Wales<br>Registered Office: Neathouse Place<br>London SW1V 1BH United Kingdom<br>Tel +44 20 7802 4000 Fax +44 20 7802 4111<p>Members of the BHP Billiton group which is headquartered in Australia<p>
